local.//base_url: Any string here may be {env:NAME}, taken from the environment when the file is read, or {env:NAME:-fallback} when it is optional. See docs/USAGE.md.

anthropic.//api_key: Omit this entirely to use the key stored by `localcode login anthropic`. {env:...} is the other way to keep a key out of this file.

strong.//fallback: Other profiles to try, in order, when this one will not answer: a rate limit, an outage, a credential that expired. Read only with smart_agent on, because falling back also re-derives the prompt for the model it falls back to. See docs/USAGE.md.

cheap.//keep_going: How many times one turn may be told to carry on after the model stops with the task unfinished. 0 (the default) defers to the model: families known to stall get 3 out of the box, everything else none. -1 forces it off. See docs/USAGE.md.

general-purpose.description: Default agent for direct user conversation: full tool access, no scoped prompt.

build.description: Implements features and fixes bugs. Full tool access.
build.prompt: You are the build agent. Focus on writing correct, working code and using tools to verify your changes. Delegate research/search-heavy sub-tasks to the explore agent via the Task tool instead of doing them yourself.

explore.description: Fast, read-only codebase search. Cheap/fast model on purpose — don't use it for anything requiring deep reasoning.
explore.prompt: You are the explore agent. Locate relevant files and summarize what you find, quickly and concisely. Do not modify anything.

plan.description: Designs a step-by-step implementation plan without making any changes.
plan.prompt: You are the plan agent. Read the codebase and propose a concrete, ordered implementation plan. Do not write or edit files — describe what should change and why.

review.description: Reviews a diff or code section for correctness bugs, security issues, and unnecessary complexity.
review.prompt: You are the review agent. Look for correctness bugs, security issues, and needless complexity — not style nitpicks. Do not modify files; report findings.

//trace_max_age_days: How long a day of Smart Agent's turn log in ~/.localcode/trace/ is kept. 30 when unset; zero or below means that default, not "keep forever". See docs/USAGE.md.
//trace_max_total_mb: Optional cap on the whole trace directory. When set, the oldest files go until it fits; today's file is never removed. Unset (0) means no size cap. See docs/USAGE.md.
//smart_agent: Off by default. On, the session's own model becomes an orchestrator with six built-in specialist sub-agents (explore, librarian, oracle, plan, implement, verify), each routed to whichever profile above suits it. Name a profile smart-quick, smart-balanced or smart-deep to pin that routing by hand. Also togglable from the settings window and with /config smart_agent on|off. See docs/USAGE.md.
